vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord Light
vesktop-themes.author: Ron
vesktop-themes.summary: Ryoku's paper and ink theme, in light mode
vesktop-themes.description: The light version of the Ryoku discord theme: the same layout, art and animations as the main theme. Enable Ryoku light in vesktop settings → themes → and check the Ryoku Light theme

vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord Calm
vesktop-themes.author: Ron
vesktop-themes.summary: Same structure and coloring but with less things: fewer animations and art
vesktop-themes.description: The calm version of the Ryoku discord theme: fewer animations, no corner ticks, plain panel titles, discord's own pictures in place of some art, and other small changes, Enable Ryoku Calm in vesktop settings → themes → and check the Ryoku Calm theme

vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord Calm Light
vesktop-themes.author: Ron
vesktop-themes.summary: The calm Ryoku theme, in light mode
vesktop-themes.description: The calm version of the Ryoku discord theme in light mode: fewer animations, no corner ticks, plain panel titles, discord's own pictures in place of some art, and other small changes, Enable Ryoku Calm  light in vesktop settings → themes → and check the Ryoku Calm Light theme

vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord No Dither
vesktop-themes.author: Ron
vesktop-themes.summary: Ryoku with smooth artwork instead of dithered
vesktop-themes.description: The Ryoku discord theme with smooth art instead of the dithered art. Enable Ryoku No Dither in vesktop settings → themes → and check the Ryoku No Dither theme

vesktop-themes.name: Ryoku Discord No Dither Light
vesktop-themes.author: Ron
vesktop-themes.summary: Ryoku with smooth artwork, in light mode
vesktop-themes.description: The no dither Ryoku discord theme in light mode, smooth art instead of the dithered art. Enable Ryoku No Dither Light in vesktop settings → themes → and check the Ryoku No Dither Light theme
